scope:
Current-family charged-particle stopping, intact-slab transmission and elastic proxy.
H/He use updated NIST evaluated stopping; CNO uses archived measured electronic
stopping plus ZBL. Ranges are distinct from retention/release probabilities.

range_scope: Intact solid normal-incidence CSDA path model. H/He projected depths are mean projected-range proxies using evaluated detour factors, not stochastic implantation profiles. No retention, backscatter, secondary yield, pore/gap transmission, diffusion or release law inferred. Electronic multipliers0.5/2 are sensitivity choices, not probabilistic intervals.
NRT_scope: 0.8*total elastic transfer/(2*Ed); Ed25/40eV. Total nuclear elastic transfer is a damage-energy proxy without electronic partition of recoils, cascade efficiency or thermal annealing. Counts are not surviving defects or mandatory atoms to replace. Electronic-excitation damage and neutral neutron transport are separate.
low_energy_scope: Below1keV: electronic sqrt(E) matched to NIST; ZBL elastic stopping; CSDA completion matched to published1keV range using lowest published range slope. Below1keV elastic energy has at most1keV/incidentHHe nucleus uncertainty; its explicit aggregate interval width is reported. Heavy-ion packets below the archived1e-10MeV stopping grid have unresolved zero path in this model; their number fraction is reported explicitly. Incoming charge-state equilibration, material temperature/microstructure and range straggling remain separate.
